RELIABILITY CONTRACT

No distributed-systems fan fiction.

01

Postgres owns reality

The broker can disappear without erasing the decision to execute.

02

Stale work cannot win

Every claim and completion is guarded by a monotonically increasing fencing token.

03

Exactly-once is not promised

Internal transitions are duplicate-safe; arbitrary external side effects are not magic.

04

Proof beats posture

Recovery, replay, and idempotency ship with tests before they earn a green status.
